answer.answer: The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) relies on Member Lending Institutions to extend assistance to non-corporate micro-enterprises [E01]. The scheme facilitates micro credit/loans up to Rs. 20 lakhs to income generating micro enterprises in the non-farm sector, with financial assistance extended by Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) including public sector banks, private sector banks, cooperative banks, rural banks, Micro Finance Institutions, Non-Banking Finance Companies, and Small Finance Banks [E01].
